daydream.description: Pale lilac canvas, white panels, and a deep plum accent with white accent ink.

afterhours.description: Blue-black charcoal surfaces with a warm apricot accent.

hint.role: notes and helper copy; smallest essential size

label.role: badges, tags, key caps, group labels

shadows.name: selection-ring
shadows.purpose: Chosen choices, swatches, and theme buttons, with an accent border.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: The chosen nature and (at 48px) the current setup step only.

motion.name: state-change

breakpoints.name: top-bar

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The main action in a local context, filled with the theme accent.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #c7b3ea; border-radius: 12px; background: #c7b3ea; color: #1b1424; font: 600 15px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #c7b3ea 88%, #f4f0f7); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7b3ea; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Everyday actions on a panel surface; mint when pressed as a toggle.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #2d2939; border-radius: 12px; background: #17151f; color: #f4f0f7; font: 500 15px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-button:hover { background: #221f2c; } .ds-button[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: #8fd3b0; color: #8fd3b0; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7b3ea; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Inset on the canvas color with a quiet border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: #b6aec2; font: 500 14px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #2d2939; border-radius: 12px; background: #100f17; color: #f4f0f7; font: 15px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #958da2; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7b3ea; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rail item
components.description: One of the four Studio places; raised when current.
components.html: LiveLookSetup1/3
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 208px; } .ds-rail a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 12px; color: #b6aec2; font: 500 15px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-rail a:hover, .ds-rail a[aria-current='page'] { background: #221f2c; color: #f4f0f7; } .ds-rail a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7b3ea; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail span { margin-left: auto; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #c7b3ea; color: #1b1424; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Choice chips
components.description: Single-choice tiles; the selected one takes the accent ring.
components.css: .ds-choices { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-choices button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #2d2939; border-radius: 12px; background: #100f17; color: #f4f0f7; font: 500 15px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-choices button:hover { border-color: #958da2; } .ds-choices button[aria-checked='true'] { border-color: #c7b3ea; background: #221f2c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #c7b3ea; } .ds-choices button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7b3ea; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented control
components.description: A raised track of options; the chosen one sits on the panel color.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 14px; background: #221f2c; } .ds-seg button { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #b6aec2; font: 500 15px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #f4f0f7; } .ds-seg button[aria-checked='true'] { background: #17151f; color: #f4f0f7; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7b3ea; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Switch
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 52px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #2d2939; } .ds-switch::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 4px; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-switch[aria-checked='true'] { background: #c7b3ea; } .ds-switch[aria-checked='true']::after { transform: translateX(20px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7b3ea; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The panel container for a group of settings.
components.html:
Energy

How lively she is between reactions.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #2d2939; border-radius: 20px; background: #17151f; color: #f4f0f7; font: 15px/1.45 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #958da2; font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Reaction key
components.description: A quick reaction on the pad, with its 1-8 hotkey.
components.html: <button class="ds-key"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M18 11V6a2 2 0 0 0-4 0v5M14 10V4a2 2 0 0 0-4 0v6M10 10.5V6a2 2 0 0 0-4 0v8a8 8 0 0 0 16 0v-3a2 2 0 0 0-4 0"/></svg>Wave<kbd>1</kbd></button>
components.css: .ds-key { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; width: 128px; min-height: 92px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #2d2939; border-radius: 16px; background: #17151f; color: #f4f0f7; font: 500 15px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: background-color 160ms, border-color 160ms, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-key svg { color: #c7b3ea; } .ds-key:hover { background: #221f2c; } .ds-key:active { transform: scale(0.97); border-color: #c7b3ea; } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7b3ea; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-key kbd { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 12px; min-width: 22px; height: 22px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #2d2939; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 12px/1 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #958da2; }

narrative.northStar: A little stage for a little personality
narrative.overview:
Tavi Studio is a calm room built around one character. A left rail holds four places (Live, Look, Personality, Setup); each screen shows one focused panel, and the two screens where her appearance matters keep Tavi in view: Live shows a 16:9 “what viewers see” preview, and Look keeps a sticky portrait stage beside the options. The design voice is playful, warm, and character-led, with a soft accent glow marking what is chosen or happening now.

Keep the interface simple and stylish, with approachable type and familiar controls: Georgia for page titles and the occasional value worth reading aloud, DM Sans for everything else, including the lowercase wordmark. Every surface reads one set of theme tokens, so Studio wears three themes (Moonlight by default, Daydream, Afterhours) chosen in the rail and remembered per browser. Themes belong to Studio only; nothing here shows on stream. Avoid adding visual complexity just to make a screen feel designed.
keyCharacteristics: One place per screen, one focused panel per place; Tavi stays visible where her look is being shaped or performed.
Quiet tonal surfaces with fine borders; the accent marks action, selection, focus, and the current step.
Generous, touchable controls: 44px targets, 15px body text, softly rounded 12–20px corners.
Warmth comes from the character, serif titles, and plain words, not decorative UI chrome.

rules.name: The Lavender Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve the accent (lavender by default; plum in Daydream, apricot in Afterhours) for actions, selection, focus, and the current step; do not use it as general decoration.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: New Studio surfaces read the theme variables, never literal hex, so every screen works in all three themes. Fixed colors are limited to things that show the stream itself (the preview backdrop and its overlay labels) and the theme swatches.

rules.name: The Warm Clarity Rule
rules.body: Prefer sentence case and plain language. Let the type feel conversational; avoid corporate all-caps labels, exaggerated tracking, and overly compressed text.

rules.name: The Earned Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow means “this is the one chosen or the one to do next.” Never use it at rest or for decoration.

dos: Do keep the character as the most distinctive and visually prominent part of the studio.
Do keep one focused panel per screen, and keep Tavi visible wherever her look or live behavior is being changed.
Do use plain, reassuring language for connection, placement, and error states.
Do keep settings grouped by what the streamer is trying to do, with consistent controls across panels.
Do keep every interactive target at least 44px and text at 4.5:1 in all three themes.
Do build new surfaces from the theme variables so Moonlight, Daydream, and Afterhours all work.
Do preserve keyboard focus visibility, the 1–8 and Esc reaction keys, reduced-motion support, and the narrow-window top bar.
Do let section headings stand on their own instead of repeating decorative eyebrow labels.
Do use the accent glow to show a meaningful choice or the next step.
donts: Don't make the interface resemble a generic corporate dashboard.
Don't add decorative gradients, badges, or cards where they do not explain hierarchy or state.
Don't make essential labels or instructions depend on text smaller than 13px.
Don't let a Studio theme change anything that shows on stream.
Don't add watermarks or textures to the stage unless they help the character read more clearly.
Don't use motion only for decoration; transitions should answer an interaction or clarify a state change.
